reason: The README clearly describes an automation plugin that uses selectable language models to review DSH approval requests and optionally grant one-time authorization while displaying the result in the interface.

summaries.zh: 通过可选的语言模型自动审查 DeepSeek Harness 的敏感操作审批请求，并在符合条件时授予一次性授权。
summaries.en: Automatically reviews DeepSeek Harness approval requests with a selectable language model and can grant one-time authorization when the request passes its checks.

capabilities: Automatically evaluates DSH operations that require approval using a selected language model
Can grant one-time approval for an operation after model and local-rule checks
Sends limited operation context to the configured model provider for review
Displays approval decisions, reasons, model details, and failures in the DSH interface
Provides commands and UI controls to enable, disable, inspect, and select the approval model
